title: fresh panel defaults to SQL + Builder with PromQL absent on a logs stream
verifies: a brand-new add-panel starts SQL + Builder selected with the PromQL toggle absent and Custom present but unselected

title: selecting the metrics stream type reveals PromQL and auto-selects it on a fresh panel
verifies: the PromQL toggle appears only for a metrics stream type and is auto-selected without a confirmation dialog

title: Builder to Custom switches immediately with no dialog and mounts the query editor
verifies: the Builder to Custom transition is immediate (never prompts) and reveals the Monaco query editor

title: Custom to Builder with a written query prompts; Cancel preserves, OK commits
verifies: Custom to Builder with a non-empty query opens the confirmation dialog, Cancel preserves Custom + query, OK commits Builder

title: Custom to Builder with an empty query switches immediately with no dialog
verifies: Custom to Builder with an empty query skips the confirmation dialog and switches immediately

title: switching PromQL custom back to SQL clears the query with no dialog
verifies: the destructive SQL/PromQL query-type switch clears the custom query and never prompts a confirmation dialog
